newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ultronics to lose major supplier ATL.
newsitem.headline: Ultronics to lose major supplier ATL.

text.p: Medical equipment supplier Ultronics International Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it would lose its major medical equipment supplier on the expiration of an existing distribution arrangement in April.

The company said an exclusive distribution arrangement with Advanced Technology Laboratories Inc (ATL) for distributing ATL's ultrasound medical equipment in Hong Kong, Macau and China would come to an end on April 30, 1997.
"Due to a recent change in ATL's business strategy, ATL has decided to terminate the arrangement," the company said in a statement.
The company said sales of ATL's equipment accounted for about 80 percent of its unaudited turnover for the year ended in December 31, 1996.

"Although the termination of the arrangements would have a negative impact on the company's business in the short term...the directors remain cautiously optimistic about the company's prospects in the medium to long term," it said.
The company said it would continue to implement a policy of diversifying its suppliers base.

It said it had entered into agreements, and two medical equipment suppliers had appointed the company as their exclusive distributor of certain ultrasound medical equipment in Hong Kong, Macau and in China.
The company also said it was in discussions with several other suppliers for acquiring similar distribution rights.
Trading in the company shares resumed on Wednesday after a one day suspension. Its shares fell HK$0.11 or 22.22 percent to HK$0.385 in early trade.
